records.name: Frans Schalekamp
records.reason: The 2026 CV dates the Cornell PhD to May 2007, NSG employment to July 2006–June 2008, and the Tsinghua postdoc to August 2008–August 2010. The contemporary Tsinghua biography confirms NSG work spanned thesis writing and completion. Tsinghua is therefore the earliest documented new post-degree appointment; continuing pre-degree employment is retained separately.
